body:
WHAT
The Settings view only has appearance, activity, context and safety controls, plus a note pointing to the connection wizard. Endpoint, API key, model, TEST and SAVE all live in the connection wizard (a modal). Vision is toggled per workspace from the sidebar/pane context menu, which changes the same `vision` setting the engine reads.

WHY
Two places to type a key could disagree, and the user could not tell which surface configured what.

WHERE
app/renderer/index.html — <section id="settingsView"> contains only set-card blocks (WORKBENCH, ACTIVITY, CONTEXT, SAFETY, glossary) and a set-note saying 'Connections live in the connection wizard'; the wizard markup is the #setupWizard modal (wizBaseUrl, wizApiKey, wizModel, wizTestBtn, wizStartBtn). app/renderer/modules/setup.js — openConnectionsWizard(mode, tabId), wizPayload(), the wizTestBtnEl and wizStartBtnEl handlers. app/renderer/modules/util.js — appendConnectionCtxItems(menuEl, tabId) adds SET CONNECTION and the VISION ON/OFF item which calls window.magentra.setVision(enabled, tabId) → app/main.js ipcMain.handle("settings:setVision").

TEST CHECKLIST
1. Inside #settingsView there is no input or button whose id starts with 'wiz', no element with placeholder or label matching /base url|api key|endpoint/i, and no button labelled TEST or SAVE.
2. The ids wizBaseUrl, wizApiKey, wizModel, wizTestBtn and wizStartBtn each occur exactly once in index.html, all inside the wizard modal.
3. The sidebar workspace context menu built by appendConnectionCtxItems contains a 'SET CONNECTION' item that opens the wizard with that row's tabId.
4. Toggling VISION from the context menu calls setVision with the row's tabId and results in settings.vision flipping in that workspace's .magentra/settings.json (and no other file).
5. The settings note text mentions 'SET UP CONNECTIONS' so the user is pointed to the only place a connection is defined.
6. We must verify connection is taken only from single source - in whole application.
